slides.title: The data is there. The understanding isn't

cards.title: Customers can't read their data
cards.text: Owners see graphs but can't tell a seasonal rise from a leak, so they call VILPE to have it explained.

cards.title: Wet installations look alarming
cards.text: Sensors fitted into still-wet structures give confusing first data. Alarms fire before there is a baseline.

cards.title: The data earns nothing
cards.text: VILPE sells hardware. Years of building data create no recurring value today.

slides.notes: Two pain points VILPE told us about, plus: the data creates no recurring value.
